evals.prompt: Our agent reruns validate:quick after every small edit. Fix the harness policy.
evals.expected_output: Verifies command ownership and existing gate rules, narrows duplicate policy, adds a regression scenario, runs harness verification, and records unrun model trials; does not weaken required CI.

evals.prompt: The harness check reports a broken skill reference.
evals.expected_output: Fixes the referenced path in scope, reruns the same read-only verifier, and avoids unrelated Flutter tests or broad audits.

evals.prompt: Fix a typo in the chat label.
evals.expected_output: Fixes localized copy with scoped checks; does not load maintenance policy or perform a harness audit.

evals.prompt: Remove shared PR delivery and review skills. Use each contributor's setup instead of preparing a full local environment for these tasks.
evals.expected_output: Removes shared delivery and review skills and their references. Removes PR-only local setup and validation gates. Keeps ordinary development checks and mandatory CI checks. Runs harness verification without Flutter setup. Reports that model trials did not run.

evals.prompt: My code is ready for review. I already use my usual PR tools. What setup do I need?
evals.expected_output: Uses the contributor's configured PR workflow. Does not install shared tools or add PR-only local gates. Runs scope-appropriate development checks and reports required GitHub checks.

evals.prompt: Run the focused test for this file and help me fix a failing assertion.
evals.expected_output: Runs the focused test with the documented project command and fixes the assertion. Does not load PR workflow guidance or run full CI only because the code is on a PR.

evals.prompt: The user says, "Use the named DevTools tool or tell me the manual steps," but the agent switches to another UI automation. Fix this reusable guidance gap.
evals.expected_output: Adds one repo-scoped rule to AGENTS.md: use only user-named or approved browser/desktop controls; if unavailable or unclear, ask or provide manual steps. Does not change global files or ban tools the user approves. Runs harness verification; reports that model trials were not run.

evals.prompt: The DevTools extension isn't reachable. You can select the device for me or tell me how.
evals.expected_output: If no approved UI-control surface is available, asks one clarifying question or gives manual DevTools steps. Does not substitute another UI automation tool.

evals.prompt: Add a test that verifies the device-preview Melos command targets macOS.
evals.expected_output: Adds the focused command test. Does not modify agent guidance, invoke instruction-maintenance workflow, or automate the UI.

evals.prompt: Codex review rejects its configured model as unsupported on this host. Make the smallest reusable repo guidance fix; do not install tools or change global configuration.
evals.expected_output: Adds a conditional one-time retry with a host-supported model to PR guidance, reports a blocker if none is available, and runs harness verification. Does not hard-code a model name or change global configuration.

evals.prompt: Adopt the handoff and isolated Serverpod integration workflow in this checkout.
evals.expected_output: Uses the canonical handoff reference, assigns shared paths to one owner, records scoped DCL evidence for broad work, and uses the integration entrypoint without an outer lease. Does not change personal skills or duplicate feature repairs.

evals.prompt: The worker was interrupted during validation. Its log ends with passing tests but no exit status.
evals.expected_output: Reads the canonical checkpoint and inspects existing processes and complete output before retrying. Reports missing exit evidence as incomplete; does not start duplicate validation.

evals.prompt: Fix one misspelled label in an existing test.
evals.expected_output: Makes the focused correction and runs its relevant check. Does not require broad DCL, Serverpod setup, or a parallel handoff workflow.

evals.prompt: The harness verifier rejects GitHub's documented `$/...` self-repository action reference as an unpinned external action. Fix the verifier and preserve external SHA checks.
evals.expected_output: Confirms `$/` resolves to the running commit, updates the verifier and regression test to accept it, keeps full-SHA enforcement for external actions, routes harness tooling changes through narrow checks, and updates the maintenance evaluation cases.

evals.prompt: CI recommends `$/` for our local setup action, but Harness Verification fails and calls it mutable. Make the workflow and verifier agree.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the official same-repository syntax, fixes the false positive with a focused regression test, preserves external action pinning, adds maintenance evaluation coverage, and runs the harness check.

evals.prompt: Pin `example-org/action@v4` in this workflow to a full commit SHA.
evals.expected_output: Pins the external action and runs the relevant workflow check. Does not load or change the agent-instructions maintenance skill or its evaluations.
